# braintrust_project_group (Resource)

Manages a Braintrust project group. A project may belong to multiple project groups.

For projects also managed by Terraform, leave `member_projects` unset and manage each relationship with `braintrust_project_group_membership`. This ensures Terraform removes membership before destroying the project or group. Inline `member_projects` requires removing membership in a separate apply before destroying a project; do not use both ownership styles for one group.

Adding projects requires `create_acls` on them, and removing projects or deleting a populated group requires `delete_acls`. Import with the project group ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique within the organization.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID for this project group.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the project group.
- `member_projects` (Set of String) Project IDs managed inline. Use separate membership resources for safe simultaneous project deletion.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `deleted_at` (String) Deletion timestamp, or null.
- `id` (String) Project group ID.
- `user_id` (String) Creating user ID.
